full_page.content:
1933, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 133 Cont.
Aug. 16 Noe Carmela - 17 mo. - blind - cannot sit up.
Mr. & Mrs. Quarrelis - middle aged - lost property paying nearly up . . . . .
John Carney - 84 - of Monterose, Pa. - cancer.
.18 Emmet W. Kennedy -55 of Niles, Mich. - Enrolled two weeks ago (% Br. F.) cancer of liver, comes to monastery To-day seemingly cured - had been enrolled (50c) in March.
Sister Monica- of Chatham, Ont. - dizzy all time - hopes to regain health for School in September.
K.X. - over 20 - 5th yr now in state-prison- on life sentence- has two sisters nuns. ...
Alice Bagley - brother out of work and wanting to be married in Oct. R.Fr. not Cath.
L. Ward - 60 - of Burt Mich. - bad hernia
Mrs. Brady - 45 - fainting spells Ci. Pifer - 30 of Pt. Huron - fearful arthritis - Mennonite .. . Not- iced .... walked better going out.
24 Page 134 Page 135 Aug 24
Anthony Padaline - 35 - scared at night - trembles
Dora Bouchard - 30 - wayward.
Francis Compeau - 16 of Merril, Mich. - paralized .... Mother has serious stomach ....
Mrs. Lauer - 85 - one eye failing - broke leg sometime ago - came from Montoe yesterday.
Rev. Fr. Mrs. Eliz. Hogan - 48 - stomach cancer - husband & 3
Edna Martel1 - 35 - married a morman, wants of Church ... intends having baby baptized at 7 . Mother died year ago, father out of employ.
